items.title: Try and Done
items.detail: A requested deliverable waits in Needs you as one Try line. Opening it no longer clears it; press Done in the reader, for the revision on screen. Undo brings it back.

items.title: Other hosts' deliverables
items.detail: Deliverables requested on another Work host appear in Needs you; Done is saved on that host.

items.title: Personal tab
items.detail: A bridged Personal host is its own tab with its own count, never added to Work's.

items.title: Reconnect and Reload
items.detail: A host that was restarting reconnects on its own. Reload reloads the host on screen.

items.title: Case actions
items.detail: A waiting case needs you only when it names what to do, and links to where you do it. Superseded versions are never offered.

items.title: Pins
items.detail: Pins on a lane follow it to its current session. The Personal view shows its peers' pins, read only.
